# claude-switch

> Open-source CLI that lets you use several Claude subscription accounts (Pro, Max, Team) in Claude Code and switches between them automatically when one hits its 5-hour or weekly usage limit. Works on macOS, Linux and Windows. Single Go binary, MIT license.

claude-switch saves each account's Claude Code login, swaps the one Claude Code uses, and reads the usage Claude Code already reports to its status line to switch at a threshold (default 95%). Running sessions follow on their next request; no logout or restart.

Install on macOS/Linux: `curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/PuntoyComaTech/claude-switch/main/install.sh | sh`
Install on Windows: `irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/PuntoyComaTech/claude-switch/main/install.ps1 | iex`
